notes.title: Update 1.31
notes.content:
Hiya,

just some basic fixes here :)

- Fixed milestone percentage (the thing that pops up at 20/40/60/80% progress) not scaling correctly with camera
- Fixed cursor not flashing to the beat after restarting a level
- Fixed cursor sometimes going invisible in main menu or level panel
- Fixed pause menu interaction in a level panel causing issues

- Cursor is now 20% funkier 

Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hiya!

New level now included: Plus One
Exceptionally difficult, now includes 5 quintants (formerly quadrants) to present a new challenge!

I hope you enjoy! More coming soon and or eventually :)

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hiya!

Some quality of life changes due to some recent feedback! :)

- Arrow Outlines now display a fill slider to help indicate when to hit the notes
- Added a custom cursor to help keep focus on where the player's mouse is
- Significantly improved overall visibility in most levels by rebalancing colors and light
- Some typo fixes
- Added Loading Screen Tips

Special thanks to Tarodev and Tarodev's discord for the feedback!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Some small graphical and performance changes

Updated Main Menu to brighter colors
Added Background to Stage 2 (Flickering Halls) to have it not feel so empty :)

Performance performs better, changed some key note behavior to run more efficiently 
Fixed Pause Menu buttons not showing animation when hovered with mouse

Upcoming 1.2:
Stage 11, more customization
